recentItems.title: King tides pound Northern California coast amid flood warnings
recentItems.description:
High waves pounded the coast of Northern California on Wednesday (November 25) with high tide records broken in San Francisco. 

Onlookers could be seen watching waves crashing ashore in Humboldt County and Pacifica, as El Nino storms led to higher than usual king tides. The high tides have led to flood warnings and evacuations in some areas. 

The tidal gauge in San Francisco hit a record 8.23 feet (2.5 meters) on Tuesday (November 24) morning, breaking the record of 7.97 feet (2.429 meters) set in 1982, according to the National Weather Service. 

(Production: Izzie Mendez, Fred Greaves, Carlos Barria, Ashraf Fahim. Editing: Ashraf Fahim. Writing: Ashraf Fahim) .

recentItems.title: Christmas attractions sunod-sunod nang nagbubukas sa iba-ibang lugar sa bansa | TV Patrol
recentItems.description:
Nagsimula nang magningning ang iba-ibang pamaskong atraksyon na dinarayo ng mga pamilya at turista.

Tampok doon ang higanteng Christmas displays, makukulay na parol at mga light show na hindi lang nagbibigay-saya kundi nagpapaalala rin ng tunay na diwa ng pasko. 

Kabilang sa mga dinarayo ang Baguio Botanical Garden na may temang 'Hymn of the White Blossoms' ngayong toan, ang Pampanga Eye sa San Fernando City, ang Christmas Wonderland sa Cavite City, at ang naglalakihang Christmas decorations sa Gapan City na kilala bilang Home of Christmas Festival.

Nagliwanag din ang mga munisipyo sa Tantangan, South Cotabato pati sa Samal at Balanga sa Bataan. 

Nagpapatrol, Gracie Rutao. TV Patrol, Huwebes, 26 Nobyembre 2026 .

recentItems.title: Drone video shows waves crashing close to homes in northern California | ABS-CBN News
recentItems.description:
El Nino storms are bringing king tides to the US west coast, causing concern for flooding in some areas.

In coastal Pacifica, California, waves are starting to breach the barrier in front of homes as they crash onto shore.

The area is under a coastal flood warning and a high surf warning, according to the National Weather Service. The warnings are set to expire on Wednesday (November 25) afternoon and overnight into Thursday (November 26), respectively. 

(Camera, Production and Editing by Sandra Stojanovic; Writing by Erica Stapleton)

recentItems.title: 'Cry To Your Mother' na winning song sa 'BINIverse and Chorus' streaming na | TV Patrol
recentItems.description:
Sa mga nagpaplanong mag-move on at iwasan ang relapse, may bagong anthem ang BINI na puwede nang isama sa playlist.

Streaming na sa iba-ibang platforms ang 'Cry To Your Mother' na nilikha nina Paris Phoebe at Joel Renker.

Ito ang winning song sa reality series na 'BINIverse and Chorus' tampok ang tagisan ng Blooms sa paglikha ng kanta para sa Nation's Girl Group.

Samantala, diretsahang kinumpirma ni Gerald Anderson na single siya at very happy.

Focused siya ngayon sa kanyang career at sa ilang projects sa likod ng camera. Full support naman si Jerald Napoles sa pangarap ng misis na si Kim Molina na muling gampanan ang papel ni Zsazsa Zaturnnah sa mas malaking entablado.

Dumayo naman sa New Zealand si Sam Milby para pasayahin ang mga Kapamilya sa "iWant Happy Hour." 

Nagpapatrol, Anna Cerezo. TV Patrol, Huwebes, 26 Nobyembre 2026 .
